#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

long long A[20];

long long compute(int index, long long number) {
    if (index == 0)
        return number == 0 ? 0 : 100000000;
    if (number < 0) number = -number;
    long long quotient = number / A[index];
    long long option1 = compute(index - 1, number - quotient * A[index]) + quotient * index;
    long long option2 = compute(index - 1, number - (quotient + 1) * A[index]) + (quotient + 1) * index;
    return min(option1, option2);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    long long n;
    cin >> n;
    A[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
        A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    cout << compute(16, n) << '\n';
    return 0;
}
